title: Canon: Characters
use_cases: Recall main character roles, desires, flaws, and relationships
content: Yi Hyang: protagonist, prince heir, modern Nobel-level inventor reborn in Joseon. Desire: transform Joseon. Need: learn that a kingdom is not a laboratory. Flaw: impatience with human and institutional limits. Sejong: father, king, patron of knowledge, moral and political counterweight; admires and fears the son's speed. Minister Han Gyeong-su: fictional conservative antagonist who defends stability and bureaucratic order with plausible arguments. Jang Yeong-sil: technical ally who translates theory into workshop reality and challenges Hyang's abstraction.
